avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Immune system stimulation may directly antagonize mycophenolate's immunosuppressive effects and increase transplant rejection risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all echinacea-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces UGT enzymes, increasing mycophenolate glucuronidation and reducing therapeutic concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if unavoidable

avoid_supplements.name: Probiotics (specific strains)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Certain probiotic strains may stimulate immune function, potentially undermining mycophenolate efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-potency multi-strain probiotics; discuss specific probiotic selection with clinician

caution_supplements.name: Antacids (calcium, magnesium, aluminum hydroxide)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce mycophenolate absorption by chelation; separate dosing recommended
caution_supplements.action: Administer mycophenolate 2 hours before or 6 hours after antacids; monitor clinical response

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May chelate mycophenolate in GI tract, potentially reducing absorption
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing by at least 2 hours; monitor for loss of immunosuppressive effect

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild immunostimulatory properties that could reduce mycophenolate efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; consider alternative adaptogens; monitor graft function

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Significantly reduces mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) absorption by 40-50%; affects peak levels and bioavailability
avoid_foods.action: Administer on empty stomach (fasting 1 hour before and 2 hours after); separate from fatty foods

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: May inhibit glucuronidation pathways; potential for increased mycophenolate exposure
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for adverse effects; maintain consistent intake pattern

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods (excessive intake)
caution_foods.mechanism: May reduce mycophenolate absorption when consumed in very large quantities near dosing time
caution_foods.action: Consume fiber at least 2 hours apart from mycophenolate dosing

caution_foods.name: Dairy products (with dosing)
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium in dairy may chelate mycophenolate if consumed simultaneously
caution_foods.action: Separate dairy intake from mycophenolate dosing by at least 2 hours

monitoring_notes: Monitor mycophenolic acid (MPA) trough concentrations (target 1-3.5 mcg/mL) and assess graft function through serum creatinine and clinical rejection markers, especially when supplements or dietary patterns change. Educate patients on strict administration timing relative to food intake, as absorption variability directly impacts immunosuppressive efficacy and transplant outcomes.
